book.name: 1 Akakolintu
book.title: Baluwa jhukutumbula jha Pauli kwa Akakolintu

content: Kuyoka kwa Kilichitu
Ngohe makalongo bhango, mbala kunkombocha Malobhe gha Mbone ghunintangachila, ghimpokii na kubhehe nchinge gwa kuhobholela kwino, na kwa gheniya mangota nnyemite nganganga.
Lilobhe lyenio linintangachii ndi Lilobhe lya Mbone, mangota nang'ombokoka anda mughakamwii maha ghala ghunintangachila, anda nahi jhe bhahe, kuhobholela kwino jhajhe.
Nenga nikampekii mangota ghala ghimbokii nenga namwete, kubhehe Kilichitu awile kwa nhwalo gwa uhakaho gwito ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga,
kubhehe awile na kuyoka lichiko lya utato ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga.
Akatumbwii kumpitii Kefa, kabhele ajhakwapitila akatenga kome na bhabhele.
Helahela ajhakwapitila akalongo mamiya nhwano kwa mala jhimo, bhamahele bhabhii ghome, nambo bhange bhajhomwike.
Paligha ajhakumpitila Yakobu, na peniya ajhakwapitila akatenga bhoha.
Kujhomolela kwake ajhakumbitii nenga, ngita mundo jhumelwikwe changatimicha miyehe jhango.
Nhwalo nenga ndi natenga jwandina pakate jha akatenga bhoha, nitope jhe kukemwa natenga, nhwalo nakaghang'ahite makunde gha bhando ghighanyeketii Kilichitu.

Nambo, kwa umbone gwa Chapanga, undei mme ngita chimile, na umbone gwake ukibha jhajhe jhe. Nenga hengite lihengo kupete akatenga bhoha, ne jhe, nambo umbone gwa Chapanga uhengita lihengo pamonga na nenga.
Kwa nhwalo gwenio, ibhehe nenga amu bheniya bhubhatangacha Malobhe gha Mbone kilebhe jhe, chenje ndi twatangachila bhando na chenje ndi chitujheketela.
Kuyoka kwa bhando
Ngohe, nhwalo itangachwa kubhehe Kilichitu ayokite kubhoke mu kuwegha, bho, nhwalo ghane bhange bhilonge kubhii jhe kuyoka?
Anda kubhii jhe kuyoka kwa bhando, bhahe, Kilichitu na jwenio ayokite jhe,
anda Kilichitu ayokite jhe, bhahe, chituntangacha kilebhe nacho, helahela kihobholelo chino kilebhe nacho.
Kupeta gheniya, helahela twenga tubhonekana tulongii uwange panane jha Chapanga, kwa nhwalo tulongii Chapanga akayokiche Kilichitu, chakaka akayokiche jhe, ngita hela bhubhawile bhahyokichwa jhe.
Nhwalo ikibha chakaka kubhehe bhubhawile kuyoka jhe, bhahe na jwenio Kilichitu ayokite jhe.
Anda Kilichitu ayokite jhe, bhahe, kihobholelo chino kilebhe nacho, na mwamela muhakaho gwino.
Helahela bhando bhubhawile kone bhannyeketii Kilichitu bhahobhalile.
Anda tuhobhalila Yecho Kilichitu muughome ghongo tugha, twenga tupalwa kubhonelwa kiya kuliku bhando bhoha pannema.
Nambo uchakaka ndi kubhehe Kilichitu ahyokichwe kuhumii muweghe, jwenio ndi jwatumbulila kuyoka pakate jha bhando bhubhagholwike mukuwegha.
Anda kuwegha kuletitwa na mundo jhumo, helahela kuyoka kubhoke muweghe na kwenie kuletitwa na mundo jhumo.
Kwa nhwalo bhando bhoha bhiwegha kwa kulombana na Adamo, helahela kwa kulombana na Kilichitu bhando bhoha bhabhehe ghome.
Nambo kila jhumo chayoka mu kipinde chake, kutumbulii Kilichitu, peniya bhala bhubhabhii bhake Kilichitu papakuhika.
Peniya, kujhomolela nakuhika, Kilichitu papakumpe Chapanga Tate unahota nkolongwa, pajhomolela kuhangabhana ulongoche na ukindendeke na makakala ghoha ghanganandela.
Nhwalo Kilichitu apalwa kulongocha ade Chapanga pahotola kwabula akamakoko bhoha na kwabheka pahe jha makongono ghake.
Likoko lya kujhomolela jwapala kukomolekelwa ndi kuwegha.

Nhwalo Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge, “Chapanga abhekite ilebhe yoha pahe jha makongono ghake.” Nambo, Majhandiko pighalonge, “Ilebhe yoha ibhekitwe pahe jha makongono gha ilongoche,” chakaka kubhehe Chapanga abhii jhe muilebhe yenio, nhwalo jwenio Chapanga ndi jwaibheka ilebhe yoha pahe jha ukindendeke gwa Kilichitu na ahoto jhe kubhehe pahe jha Kilichitu.
Nambo papala kubheka pahe jha ulongoche gwa Kilichitu, na jwenio Mwana chatama pahe jha ulongoche gwa Chapanga, jwabhekite yoha pahe jha ulongoche gwake, nhwalo Chapanga ilongocha yoha kila chehemo.
Ngohe anda kuyoka kubhii jhe, bho, bhando bhala bhubhatichwa kwa nhwalo gwa bhubhawile nabhatenda bho? Anda bhubhawile bhayokichwa jhe, nhwalo ghane bhando bhibatichwa kwa nhwalo gwabhe?
Nhwalo ghane na twenga tukibheka ngenyangenya jha ngondo kila lichaa?
Makalongo bhango, machiko naghabhaha mukuhandahanda jha ngondo jha kuwegha! Nikiloka kwa nhwalo gwino mu kulombana na Yecho Kilichitu Bhambo gwito, ghindenda nnonge ghanga.

Bho, nganyambulile kilebhe ghane pangomina na bhando bhubhalandine na inyama ijhoghowa kwenio ku Epecho? Nambo anda bhando bhubhawile nabhahyokichwa jhe bhahe, “Tulye na tunyweghe, nhwalo kilabho natuhwa.”
Nkotoka kukopokelwa, “Ukoche gwanganandela uhangabhana luhomo lwambone.”
Ngohe ung'ang'anuke! Nkoto kutenda uhakaho, nhwalo bhando bhange pakate jhino chakaka bhammanyite jhe Chapanga. Nilonge mambu ghanga nkola hone!
Yegha jha kuyoka
Nambo mundo ahotola kukonya, “Bho, bhubhawile bhayoka bhole? Bho, chibhabha na yegha ghane?”
Ngonyelo jhene jha kimbebhebhe! Mbejho yumichite imela jhe ade ihwe hote.
Paumichita, umicha mbejho tugha, ibhe ya ngano amu mbejho henge, umicha jhe mmea ghupitila.
Chapanga haipela mbejho liumbo lyalipala jwenio, kila mbejho libhehe na liumbo lya kanjika chake.
Yegha ihumbi yoha ilandine jhe. Bhando bhakwete yegha jhabhe na inyama ikwete yegha yabhe, ijhune ikwete yegha yabhe na helahela homba ikwete yegha yabhe.
Kabhele yegha ya kunane kwa Chapanga na yegha ya pannema, uwalanao gwa yegha ya kunane kwa Chapanga ilandinejhe na uwalanao yegha ya pannema.
Lyobha libhii lya mbone na lubhalamwehe lubhii lwa uwalanaho na ndondwa ibhii na uhwalanaho gwake, na ndondwa yenio ilandinejhe muhwalanao.
Yene ndi chipala kubhehe bhando pubhapala kuyokichwa kwa bhando bhubhawile. Yegha uchikwa kone ubholite, nambo uyoka changahangabhika.
Uchikwa muhone, uhyokechwa muukolo, uchikwa kone uleghelike, uyokichwa mumakakala.
Pauchikwa, uchikwa anda yegha jha umundo, peniya uyoka yegha jha kiuhuke. Anda ibhii yegha jha kiumundo, helahela ibhii yegha jha kiuhuke.
Nhwalo Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghalongela, “Mundo jwa kutumbula, Adamo, akibha mundo ghome,” nambo Adamo jwa kujhomolela ndi Uhuke gwa Chapanga jwabhapekea bhando ughome.
Yegha jha kiuhukejhe jhilongolile, nambo yegha jha kiumundo ndi ulongolile, peniya ijhakuhika yegha jha kiuhuke.
Mundo jwakutumbulila akapanginwe kuhumii mulutukunda lwa nnema, nambo mundo jhubhele abhokite kunane kwa Chapanga.
Bhando bha pannema bhalandine na bhala bhapanginwe kwa undope, na bhala bhahumita kunane kwa Chapanga ndibhahumite kunane kwa Chapanga.
Anda yenio chitulandine na jhola jwapanginwe kwa undope, helahela chatulandine na jhola jwahumita kunane kwa Chapanga.

Bhahe akalongo bhango chinilongela ndi chenje, chela chikipanginwe kwa yegha na miyahe kihotolajhe kubhujhila unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga, hilu chela chikihangabhika kihotolajhe kuleka kuhangabhika.
Nyokanikihe, ninobholele chile, bhoha natujhomoka ndeka, nambo bhoha natughalambulwa.

Chwechwele kuchichila na kuhumbula anda liho pulikopekopela. Nhwalo lipenenga la kujhomolela pilipala kulela, bhubhawile chibhayokichwe kone yegha jhabhe ibholitejhe, peniya na twenga natuwejhe, nambo natughalambulwa.
Nhwalo yegha jhihangabhika ipalwa ughalambuke kubhehe gwangahangabhika, yegha jhiwegha ighalambuke kubhehe jhangawegha.

Bhahe, yegha jhenje jhihangabhika puighalambuka ikoto kuhangabhika, na chela chikibhii mukuwegha pakighalambuka kikoto kuwegha, peniya ndi chilitimile Lilobhe lya Chapanga lililongela, “Kuwegha kukomalikilwe, kituhotojhe kabhele!”

content.text: “Mwe kuwegha, bho, kuhoto kwino kubhii ko?
Mwe kuwegha bho, lipyanda lino libhii ko?”

content: Kuwegha kubhehe na likakala nhwalo gwa uhakaho, na uhakaho libhehe na makakala nhwalo gwa lilaghalikilo.
Nambo tunchenguu Chapanga jwatupekii likakala kupetela Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu.
Bhahe akalongo bhango, nnyemengane nganganga changa nyukunyuka. Machiko ghoha nnyendelele kuhenga lihengo lya Bhambo, nhwalo umanya kubhehe lihengo lino kwa kuntumikii Bhambo lya jhajhe jhe.
